decision.explanation: The question asks for the director(s) of films titled 'The Charge of the Light Brigade'. The sources confirm three distinct films with this title: the 1912 film directed by J. Searle Dawley (D1S1, D1S2, D7S1, D7S2), the 1936 film directed by Michael Curtiz (D4S1, D4S2), and the 1968 film directed by Tony Richardson (D2S2, D2S3, D5S4, D6S1, D7S3). While some source segments (D2S1, D3S2) incorrectly attribute the 1912 film to Steven Spielberg, these are factual errors within the text and do not constitute valid evidence for an answer. The instruction to preserve distinct valid referents requires listing all three verified directors corresponding to their respective films.
